nom: First Aid Beauty Ultra Repair Rescue Barrier Balm with 1% Dimethicone

avis.titre: Perfect for my eczema and dryness
avis.texte: I was looking for something to use when I have eczema flare-ups on my face. This product was so gentle, not oily or greasy and exactly what I was looking for.

I received a tube of this in a subscription box and I'll be honest, because of the tube I thought it was hand cream. I got to say though, the stuff is amazing. I was working in a kitchen for 2 months and my hands dried out so horribly that they were cracked and peeling. I was miserable and no cream that I used worked until I put this on my hands. The relief was instant. Even knowing that this is a face cream now, I'm still going to use it on my hands because nothing else has come close to this. With my oily skin type, this is far too heavy for my face anyways.

I pick at my skin a lot and accidentally did a very rough extraction that damaged my skin barrier and make it super dry and leathery. I ordered this hoping it would help the dryness, and it almost completely fixed it overnight. It's also great at providing a barrier for any bumps I pick at.

i've been using this brand for a long time and absolutely love it. when i went on isotrentinoin for the second time, i knew i needed a product to keep my skin hydrated. this is my HOLY GRAIL product, im off isotrentinoin now but still use every day!

I have cpap dermatitis, Ive been using a cpap mask on my face whether full face or just nasal mask Ive broken out bad in the past. Ive used liners and eczema creams and this is the one thats helping my skin look and feel more even and not dry, crepey and red where the mask sat. Ive been using this most mornings for the past week or 2 and my face recovers from the cpap mask so fast. I wipe with micellar wipes, air dry, use a hydrating pillow pad, air dry again, then use this, air dry again, then apply my mineral sunscreen that contains naiacinimide. Im going to subscribe.

I dont have enough good things to say. I bought this on a whim because i tried it out in store and it felt nice on my skin but this is actually incredibly helpful for your skin barrier. I woke up one day with a strange patch of flaky skin behind my ear that was itchy and painful due to the scratching. ( i believe it was due to a new shampoo i tried out) i put this on before bed after a shower and by the next day i was pain free, the scabs were ready to be flaked off, and my ear was back to normal. Ive also used it after facial extraction appointments when my skin tends to be a little angry and it heals things so nicely. For dry skin or sensitive skin girlies, i could not recommend this enough. I love first aid products but they did their big one with this. You need it!!!!
I love how thick and soothing this cream is. I hate the aluminum tube so bad. It tears and makes difficult to squeeze the product out

I use this on my daily walks. I struggle with windburn on my face when i dont wear makeup (who wants to put makeup on every morning to workout! Lol) so in the winter this is an absolute must. Its been a life saving product that actually works. Does not feel greasy and i use it on my hands too. Love fab!!!

I'm not someone who is sensitive to products but this made my face burn. I thought that was strange and can't figure out why. Very thick and rich formula which is just what I wanted but did not deliver for my skin in particular.
Glad I got this on sale. It's not super moisturizing. It also caused contact dermatitis on my son. I do like this brand but will stick with the ultra repair cream.

Like the title says, PLEASE NEVER STOP MAKING THIS. It works great as a skin protectant but I read somewhere that silicone products work well under foundation for people with large pores so I started experimenting with this plus a primer and its my new secret weapon. It makes my foundation look 10x better. Would definitely recommend!

I have acne prone skin and I feel like it actually made my acne a bit calmer which was great. The downside is i feel kike it actually made my skin drier when i woke up…? I put it in before I go to bed and its a thick cream and feels great but when i wake up its so dry but like in a different way than before i was using it. I'll keep it for my hands maybe but wont repurchase. I have FAB's other/old packaging intensive repair cream and its great.

avis.titre: Helped the Eczema on my face
avis.texte: I have horrible eczema on my face (mostly around my mouth and nose) to the point where I wake up with very dry and flakey skin around said area. Its hard to even move my mouth in the morning due to the area being so dry. I purchased this product with little hope and fearing it might make everything worse but I listened to the reviews and took the risk! It definitely has helped relieve the discomfort due to the eczema and it only heals it temporarily. I ran out of the product and went a week without it and definitely felt the eczema worsening again as it used to be. My point is, it definitely helps with temporary relief and is very hydrating, I recommend buying.
Got this just in time for Midwest snow storms. I use it on my face and hands for instant dryness relief

Currently use this as a hand cream for extreme eczema that dries and cracks thats painful i was needing something thick and unscented and this is perfect! since using this its helped so much i am on my second tube of it.

I live in the midwest where winters are frigid and my skin dries up like raisin. I've tried everything from mid range to very expensive moisturizers and this beats them all. I just ordered another so I'll have a backup.

avis.titre: Good with no cons, but pricey for what it is
avis.texte: As someone with very dry sensitive skin and eczema as well, this lotion works well for me. It's rich but not greasy and never broke me out or caused irritation. That being said…there are other lotions and balms very similar to this that are $20 cheaper. I probably won't rebuy for that reason, but I have no real cons. I will say that the coloring is starting to rub off of the tube — it looks nice but i think maybe the packaging is a little cheap and they just wanted the aesthetics of the crinkle tube over plastic.
I have a small mark on my face from where a small slice was taken for a biopsy. I have been using the Ultra Repair Rescue on it and the mark is now less visible.

i've been using this in the mornings & on nights that i skip my tretinonin in my routine. it helped my skin barrier after i wrecked it with too much tretinonin at the start. it feels nice & smooth & absorbs really well.
It's OK. Not as moisturizing as described in my experience. For an "ultra repair" product, I feel it fell short.

avis.titre: The ultra repair rescue barrier balm
avis.texte: This product is really good I bought it for my son because his hands were really irritated and I tried everything else and nothing worked .so I went to ultra and asked if they had anything that they thought would work and this was the product. I would definitely recommend buying it.it's not greasy

avis.titre: Love love love this barrier cream
avis.texte: First time using this for a few weeks now and it has claimed its spot in my skincare routine! I use this as the very last step in my PM skincare routine. I do not have sensitive skin, so ive been using this all over my face but really focusing on the sides of my nose (barrier was ruined due to a cold and over exfoliation) and my forehead (tends to get crepey due to dehydration). I have used this during the day as well with SPF as the last step on no make ul days and have had no issues. Currently unsure how this would work with makeup on top.
This is a good winter moisturizer but it's not a balm. Similar to a cicaplast cream. I have dry sensitive skin and use this around my nose in thr winter and it helps.

It's not what the product is advertized as, but this is the only product I've ever used that has healed my dry, cracked cuticles. I've previously used cuticle oil daily with minimal results. This helps soothe any painful areas (rash, eczema, cuticles(!), etc). Highly recommend!

i do not have sensitive skin at all and this still burns when i put it on even if my skin barrier is not damaged. it also is not moisturizing at all in fact i think it made my skin drier. after using it my skin became flaky with dry patches. ive never had a reaction like this before i just cannot reccomend there are better products
I have eczema and very dry, sensitive skin. This product helps me tremendously!!

My perioral dermatitis typically flares up with the colder months and this balm has done wonders to manage dryness and flaking around my nose and mouth. My skin is much calmer and clearer thanks to the addition of this balm!
I burnt my skin after using clay mask from the other brand. I found this product and tried this. The result shows within 2 days after using that.
Im nearly 50, been through every brand / type / thickness / ingredients and this is hands down the very best lotion ive ever used.

avis.titre: Great for sensitive and dry skin
avis.texte: This is working miracles for my eczema and extremely sensitive and dry skin. It's amazing

I have been using every hand lotion , Vaseline, petroleum products for my hands. I work with my hands. They are dry and when I wash, and Santize , it makes it worse. This product works so good I couldn't believe only after applying a small pea size it makes my skin feel so nice and looks normal not dried up.
I originally got this item in my Ipsy box, and after 1 use I had to buy the big one. It makes my skin so smooth and soft. And feels amazing on my sensitive skin. 10/10 product

My roomate got a cat that i was allergic to where my eyes would swell and get dry, flaky, and itchy. Regular allergy meds helped with the swelling but not the dermatitis. This helped me get the skin on my eyelids back to normal. They dont flake or get super dry. Amazing product

I constantly suffer from dry and irritated skin around my nose. It gets so bad to the point where my skin next to my nose is literally ripping and bleeding. Using this balm for a week twice a day once in the morning once at night healed my nose. Now I will say once I stopped using it as well my skin cracked again so now I use this product daily and my nose thanks me.

It is amazing I use it on my eczema and/or use it all over my face at night and wow. A great product will heal a compromised skin barrier overnight. Will be purchasing again. And won't clog your pores. It's also great for your hands. You will love it

avis.titre: Great for eczema and other skin problems
avis.texte: I wish I found this stuff sonner. I've been struggling with eczema and perioral dermatitis for months and regular moisturizers just don't cut it. I started using this at night after applying a topical antibiotic and my skin feels so much better after just a few days. It's a little heavy feeling at first but after absorbing a little it feels like nothing. It's also not greasy or oily which is great for use at bedtime.
This has been amazing for my dry skin. I have a problem with millia and this has helped a lot in my routine. It feels great going on my skin. Please don't change a thing except the price!

avis.titre: What I use for my eczema
avis.texte: I was skeptical abour using this product when I bought it because I've tried a lot of creams/ointments to help treat my ezcema. I refuse to use steroid creams/ointments again because of the withdrawl it had on my skin. This product is my holy grail. I have severe ezcema on the toos of my hands, elbows and tops of my feet. My skin gets triggered by weather changes, heat, and sometimes food. This cream/balm keeps my skin from having crazy flare ups, and very much reduces the texture and look of my ezcema. I will continue to purchase this balm when I run out of my current one!

avis.titre: Not moisturizing, it dries out my oily skin!
avis.texte: This doesn't feel moisturizing at all, my skin doesn't feel soft in the morning. It actually dries out my skin, even though I have very oily skin. And definitely doesn't feel like it protects the skin barrier at all. I don't have acne prone skin, but this has caused breakouts!!!

This helped my skin rebalance, clear up and feel so hydrated! My skin was acne prone and super sensitive, this cream saved it! My only discord is the packaging but it's such a great product that I'll overlook but just hope they change it eventually!

avis.titre: Love the product, dislike the tube
avis.texte: The product is great, especially for a hand cream. My hands are prone to eczema and certain lotions burn, but this works good! I just don't like the old school metal tube. Each time you use it, the tube keeps pushing more out. Then you cant get all the product out when its low. I found it very wasteful.

avis.titre: Solved my flaky oily dry skin issue
avis.texte: This is a surprise hit for me! My skin is sensitive, itchy, prone to breakouts, and dry yet oily (flaky on nose and chin). This has solved all of that! I've only been using it 2x a day for a week and wow 😲 ! No more redness. My skin feels soft, smooth, and balanced - no more dry and flaky and oily at the same time. A little goes a long way so the big tube will last a while. I usually break out a few days after trying a new product, but not this time. Love it!
I recently got this as a sample, and I used it after my skin was dry from a retinoid. I think it worked just fine I use a tiny bit only where the dryness occurs due to sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Not where near Instant Angel unfortunately
avis.texte: Not Instant Angel. This is a low tier barrier cream given the price, it is not worth it if you have issues with whiteheads or clogged pores. Returning to the stores I bought it from.
I've been applying this cream to my tattoos and its done wonders for the healing process. Also use on my face as needed and it has helped my skin a lot.

The stuff is the BEST!!! I absolutely love it. I have autoimmune (Lupus) which means my skin can be super sensitive and hyper reactive…this always calms my face and I wake up better than the day before. I don't understand the negative reviews. Also…where can I get one of those keys for rolling down my tube? 🤭😉

had super dry, flakey skin on my nose for the longest time. i would exfoliate, moisturize, even put aquaphor on my nose nightly to try and heal it. makeup wouldnt stay on my nose either. but this immediately fixed that issue. love it so much and its so affordable!

I have been using Eucerin Eczema Relief on my hands for the past month or so and my hands have still been irritated and red but I received this stuff on TUESDAY of this week (its Friday) and my hands already look and feel so much better. I have already went back and ordered the face cream.
I received a sample of this rescue balm with another order. It is the answer to my dry finger tips and heels. I will be ordering more. Thanks First Aid

This cream is OK... I have extremely dry skin and am also on an acne medication, when I saw reviews online of people who also are on retinols/oids raving about this I decided to try it. I mean it's fine... but for the price point I won't be repurchasing, but I will finish my tube up. I will say it feels nice applying and does dry down well, but kind of tacky. I typically layer a thick moisturizer under this product as well.

avis.titre: Need this desperately for under eyes
avis.texte: I bought this for pick up today to help the skin under and around my eyes thats super dry, red and itchy. It gets irritated from too much retinol. This resolved the dryness immediately today. I couldn't be happier.

This wasn't as "bamly" as i had hoped. Its more like a thick moisturizer. That aside, this sady gave me painful cystic acne. I use all First Aid Beauty in my routine but once i added this here came the acne. It isn't scented, was easy to apply but for the price its just a thick moisturizer imo.

My go-to for harsh New England winters that compromise my skin and leave my face painfully dry & tight. In winter I use this twice a day: I apply nightly as the final step in my skincare routine and as the penultimate step before sunscreen in the morning. In warmer weather I use this every night as the final step in my evening skincare routine to lock in my products and keep my skin looking bouncy and hydrated.
I love this product. I've been using for almost a month now and it feels very light on my skin, which I love. I use this after applying tret at night and it works great for me.

Ok the title is dramatic.. but! I waited so long to purchase, finally nought it, tried it and its AMAZING. It did what my eczema prescription could not. I have very sensitive skin around my eyes and mouth and this just fit so perfectly into my skin routine.
Wanted tonight to solve the dryness on my face and neck but got some type of rash from iit. It did resolve dryness but the bumps after use didn't convince me to keep using it.

I tried this bevause my skin has been teally struggling on trentinoin, i have experienced reallt bad flakey skin and thought this would help, felt amazing on my hand in the store but when i tried it on that night it burned my face so bad i was in tears

I bought this because one I love colloidal oatmeal, and my skin gets so dry in the winter no matter what I put on. This really seals in the moisture and when I use this after my moisturizer my skin does not get irritated and dry patches when I go out! The worst areas are around my nose, around my mouth and cheeks and this really does the job.
It was fine. I barely used it a week and it didn't break me out, but it DEFINITELY dried my skin out. I will use it as a spot treatment after popping and messing with my face, but not for all over.
This cream is amazing, it's super hydrating without feeling greasy or heavy. It feels very light in the skin. Best for winters! Highly recommended!
This cream is amazing, it's super hydrating without feeling greasy or heavy. It feels very light in the skin. Best for winters! Highly recommended!
My favorite product ever! Cleared my dry skin and eczema in less than a week. Already buying a backup
This stuff is amazing! It has done wonders on my dry hands. I could see a significant improvement with one application. I only wish it came in a bigger tub.
Super hydrating as expected, blends great and no greasy after feeling. Definitely nourishing for my winter skin
Sigh .. 1 star for doing what it claims as my skin did feel good and not dry but it gave me a horrible reaction and cystic acne all of my face . :(

avis.titre: Works well but not receiving the full amount
avis.texte: Works very well but it came only half full… wont be buying again due to that manufacturing issues
I loved FAB and this stuff SAVED my acne prone dry winter skin. Highly recommend for anyone that needs to repair their barrier
This is absolutely fantastic, especially for winter, it doesnt feel too cakey or anything, just super moisturizing and hydrating!

This is literally the best! It's save my skin this winter! I had a cold about 2 wks ago and my nose was irritated from tissues! Only thing that gave me relief and keep it hydrated! I love it too all over my face after I use my serums and moisturizer. Love it!!!
Love this barrier cream for winter skin. Would rather have it back in. Jar rather than the tube.

I was looking for a new cream I could use because I use a retinoid called Arazalo that I'm pretty sure damaged my skin barrier. At first thought this was working, but noticed some bumps on my chin and on my forehead. Going to return it soon.

I started using this in addition to my daily moisturizer in the harsh cold, and it feels so smooth and is an amazingly light extra barrier! I will continue using this throughout the winter, especially on chapped or irritated skin.

I never, ever write reviews for anything, but this is the best thing I have ever put on my face. I'm 48 and a super fair-skinned redhead. I have rosacea which means my face becomes red more frequently during the winter. The redness is more pronounced the older I get. This product is magic! I could sit right next to a heater all day long, and my cheeks aren't even pink. This is so smooth going on, and it's very easy to put a thinner amount during the day and a thicker amount overnight. Barrier cream is one of the best things you can do for your skin. This particular one is exceptional.
This amazing product left my skin feeling super soft. My dry skin felt hydrated and less irritated. The overall look of my face improved with using this amazing product a little over 1 month.

I've been using First Aid Beauty's Ultra Repair Rescue Barrier Balm for the past few weeks. This balm has really helped hydrate my combo skin this winter. I especially like to use this in my PM routine after using a retinol or other active. This balm locks in the moisture, leaving my skin soft, smooth, and hydrated. I also tend to get really dry hands in the winter. I like to apply this to the tops of my hands before bed. This balm has been the perfect addition to my skincare routine this winter.

I have post eczema skin damage. and this cream is a blessing it protects my skin all day long specially during this extremely bad weather. i love it.

avis.titre: New FAVE Moisturizer, esp for winter!!
avis.texte: I have the absolute driest skin ever, especially in the winter months. This Ultra Repair Rescue Skin Barrier Balm has been a total game-changer for my skin's hydration! It locks moisture in without a greasy feeling. A little goes a very long way, and the container lets you get every last drop out, which I also love. I have been using it at night, and by morning the dry patches are gone! It's fantastic!
Love this as an almost sleeping pack like item. Think it's great for sensitive dry skin. I like that it's a tube so l can get everything out easily.

This balm is thick and comforting, melting into the skin without feeling greasy. It deeply soothes and locks in moisture, leaving my face soft and protected. A little goes a long way, and it's perfect for tackling dryness or calming irritation. The texture is rich but easy to work with, and it creates a subtle, dewy finish that feels luxurious. It's become my go-to for extra care when my skin needs it most.

I can not say enough good things about this cream. I have been dealing with the worst eczema on my face lately my cheeks have been chapped and red. My eye lids were so dry and peeling. I got this cream 3 days ago! Yes 3 days! And my skin feels so good and it works so well. I'll continue to buy this! It's worth the money!!

avis.titre: First Aid Beauty comes to the Rescue
avis.texte: This barrier cream has really saved the day during these cold weather months. Normally, my skin is dry and itchy but not with this amazing product! I've even used it on my hands since they seem to get the brunt of the dry skin. Definitely will be keeping this in my skincare lineup from here on out!

I was excited this dropped right as I ran out of my regular first aid beauty ulta repair cream- I think I might return for the standard bottle- product is thicker and once it dries your skin feels really soft but I'm missing the thinner consistency of the original
Love this product! It's so nice and hydrating. Feels great on the skin and perfect for when I need extra hydration.

I have been using this on my hands for over a week and I really really enjoy it. My hands are incredibly dry and my knuckles stay terribly cracked and crusty. A combo of washing them and winter temps keeps me needing something super hydrating. This product keeps them nourished and my hand tattoos looking bold and bright. I also think it lasts really well on my skin. Fingers crossed FAB releases this in a tub for the whole body. Xoxo
Incredible. I love in such a windy, dry and harsh climes and have insanely sensitive skin. This balm is a game changer.

I have dry skin that becomes extremely dry over the winter. I typically have to apply moisturizers several times throughout the day and try not to mess up makeup when I reapply produxts. This rescue barrier balm calms my overly dry skin and even though it has a nice thickness to it, it absorbs into skin well. I have used this alone and also with foundation and it keeps my skin hydrated throughout the day without changing the integrity of my makeup. I like that there is no scent to the product.

I have been loving using this balm to protect my skin anytime I have to go outside for a bit in the cold! I have very sensitive skin and this really helps to protect and lock in moisture when its needed most!
I really like using this balm when its cooler or my skin feels like to needs some extra help or protection from the cold!

My hands have been so dry this winter so FAB has come to the rescue with their ultra repair rescue barrier balm. Dimethicone is an occlusive which means it helps seal in the moisture on my hands. You can use this balm in different ways but I like to use it as a hand cream the most. This multi-use balm was given to me complimentary from FAB.

There was a lot of hype about this being great for hydration and I'm glad to say it has helped my issue. My skim gets a bit more dry in the colder months so I needed an extra layer of protection and with the short time I've started to use this I've noticed a positive difference. Plus it was okay with my areas that are a bit more sensitive.

This has quickly become my very favorite moisturizer to use its quiet thick and I really like that about it! I love that theres no fragrance or anything that causes irration or redness to my skin my skin has had dryness often in the snowier months weve had and I was looking for something a bit thicker and creamier than my usual moisturizer! Id recommend this for lasting hydration!

I was a fan of the rescue product to begin with and this has been a huge hit. The cream leaves my skin hydrated all day. This is the perfect product as the winter comes and my skin get dry or for when ive been in the sun too long and need extra moisturizing

There's many uses for this ultra repair rescue barrier balm, but my favorite use is a makeup primer. The dimethicone gives my makeup a nice base. It's better than my other makeup primers because it has great skincare benefits in it too. I'm a big fan of it and was graciously gifted this amazing product from First Aid Beauty for my honest review.

After a few tries, I already love this product. My skin is very sensitive and can get dry, but I don't always love thick creams. This is the perfect option, as it's light weight and doesn't irritate my skin, while also keeping it moisturized and smooth. Definitely recommend!
This definitely helped repair my very dried cracked skin from the cold. Very simple to apply on.

Winter must have! It's helped with my dry hands and dry cheeks. It's a true multitasker for this cold winter. It's heavy and don't need to use it everyday for my combo skin. Haven't noticed any breakouts from using this. Recommend for all, love First Aid Beauty!

Winter must have! It's helped with my dry hands and dry cheeks. It's a true multitasker for this cold winter. It's heavy and don't need to use it everyday for my combo skin. Haven't noticed any breakouts from using this. Recommend for all, love First Aid Beauty!

This is just what my dry skin needed to bring it back to life! The formula is rich and luxurious, once it's applied it dries down nicely and doesn't feel heavy or tacky on the skin. Instead my skin is noticeable more nourished and hydrated. I love how soothing the balm feels on the skin too. I think the packaging is cute and I know I'm going to be reaching for it so much during these colder months!

I use this hydrating balm for everything when I need fast relief. It instantly soothes and deeply quenches dry,cracked skin from hands, cuticles,face, and anywhere else! I love using it when my lips are really dry, and then sealing that protection with lip gloss. This balm feels more like a hydrating cream than a traditional balm. It's not heavy, oily, thick nor greasy. It absorbs into skin and hydrates. A little goes a long way and these small amounts throughout the day, my skin feels so much better and looks better. By night time, I don't even need to apply it. I definitely feel that First Aid Beauty formulated a great product for dry skin relief here!

avis.titre: Barrier support. locks in moisture and protects skin

avis.titre: Barrier locks in moisture and protects skin
avis.texte: Have been using this for the past 2 almost 3 weeks now. I love it! I created the perfect barrier to lock in moisture! Perfect for after intense skin care treatments, harsh conditions, dry it cheaper skin.

This has been my skin's savior this winter!! I have been feeling so dry and flakey which is abnormal for my usually combo skin. Once i started using this my skin was feeling back to its plump normal self in just a week!! Will always keep this on hand for when my skin starts to freak out!

My skin barrier has been destroyed in the cold minnesota winter but after just one use i noticed such a great difference. My sensitve skin loves this. I like this so much more than the La Roche Possay barrier cream. Before using this my face was so dry that it physically hurt.
